title: Paired circuit encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $r$ be a finite Boolean list, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $2n+2+|r|$ inputs, gates in topological order, valid earlier-vertex references, and a valid output vertex. Its paired encoding is the circuit on $n$ inputs obtained by buffering its inputs according to the paired wire assignment.
hypotheses_covered: circuit $C$ on $2n+2+|r|$ inputs, with gates in topological order and valid earlier-vertex references
